description: The plot illustrates how Macro-F1 Score varies with the number of tokens for two experimental conditions, shown as two colored lines with shaded uncertainty bands. The x-axis is labeled “Number of tokens,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 0.5 to 1.5 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, and 1.4. The y-axis is labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%)”, uses a linear scale, and ranges from about 47 to 59 with tick labels at 48, 50, 52, 54, 56, and 58. One series is a pink solid line with circular markers and a semi-transparent pink band; it starts near 55.1 at 0.5 tokens, moves through about 54.5 (0.6) and 54.3 (0.7), rises to about 57.0 (0.8), is around 56.3 (0.9), peaks near 57.9 (1.0), then declines to about 55.4 (1.1) and 53.0 (1.2), is about 52.6 (1.3), increases to about 53.5 (1.4), and ends near 50.9 at 1.5. The other series is a purple solid line with circular markers and a semi-transparent purple band, labeled in the legend as “w/o material information”; it begins around 52.5 at 0.5, is about 52.6 (0.6), rises to roughly 54.1 (0.7), then is about 53.3 (0.8) and 53.3 (0.9), decreases slightly to about 52.9 (1.0) and 52.8 (1.1), is about 52.4 (1.2), dips to around 51.7 (1.3), rises to about 53.3 (1.4), and drops to roughly 47.9 at 1.5.
